finka: Lera "Finka" Melnikova was born in Gomel, Belarus. A gifted student, she trained as a doctor before moving into research on nanotechnology and its use in battlefield medicine. Her work on nanobot-based treatment led her to the Spetsnaz CBRN unit, where she served during chemical and biological threat responses. Rainbow recruited her for that expertise, and her Adrenal Surge gives her whole team a boost when it matters most.
fuze: Kessikbayev grew up in a military family in Samarkand, Uzbekistan. After his family emigrated to Russia shortly before the collapse of the Soviet Union, Kessikbayev followed in his father's footsteps and enrolled in the military, where his facility with technology landed him a spot in the coveted weapon testing brigade at Alabino firing range near Moscow.
glaz: Glazkov was born and raised in Vladivostok, Russia where his father worked in the shipping industry. Glazkov studied art in secondary school, until the Beslan school hostage crisis inspired him to transfer to the Cadet Corps and pursue a career in the armed forces.
kapkan: Born and raised in Kovrov, Basuda is the son of factory workers. To escape a life in the factory, he enlisted with the Ministry of Internal Affairs and was sent to a small port town on the Barents Sea. Basuda became an avid hunter and trapper during his time in the Arctic Circle.
tachanka: Alexsandr Senaviev is an iconoclast who came of age in a pre-glasnost red army family and has retained an interest in soviet machinery and weaponry.
